# Microsoft Q&A

> Microsoft Q&A is a community-driven technical support platform where developers and IT professionals ask questions and find answers about Microsoft technologies.

This is the official Microsoft Q&A community platform integrated with Microsoft Learn, providing peer-to-peer support and knowledge sharing across Microsoft's product ecosystem including .NET, Azure, Microsoft 365, and enterprise solutions.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Q&A
- Microsoft Learn
- .NET
- Azure
- Microsoft 365
- Microsoft Teams
- Entra
- SharePoint
- SQL Server
- Office
- Outlook
- Microsoft Edge
- community-qa
- technical-support
- developer-resources

## Getting Started

- [Microsoft Q&A | Microsoft Learn](https://answers.microsoft.com/): Homepage for Microsoft Q&A community platform for technical questions on .NET, Azure, Teams, and other Microsoft technologies
